unmapped_fields.reason: Modern has no provider-less subscription lifecycle: `subscriptions` is the Stripe object (0017: provider CHECK = 'stripe', plan CHECK pro|enterprise, partial unique index on active rows). The legacy lifecycle (none|active|past_due|grace|expired|cancelled, plus plan_started_at/plan_expires_at/plan_updated_at) therefore has NO target; the user-visible fact is preserved in users.plan. Needs an owner decision — MG-SCHEMA-MAPPING.

No modern equivalent exists for the legacy per-row boundary taint; the instant is present and validated, so the flag carries no decision. Recorded here rather than loaded into a column nobody reads — MG-SCHEMA-MAPPING.
